summary: Meta AI released Brain2Qwerty v2, a non-invasive brain-to-text decoding research system, along with its training code and (via a partner) the v1 dataset.

practices.reason: The reported word-accuracy benchmark and NeuralBench evaluation framework describe a measurement approach specific to brain-decoding research, not a transferable instrument for general AI engineering teams.
practices.quote: achieving a word accuracy rate of 61%, significantly improving upon the 8% word accuracy from other non-invasive methods

practices.reason: The use of AI agents to search decoding-pipeline configurations is a technique mention without enough specification or generality to implement elsewhere.
practices.quote: We also deployed AI agents to explore optimizations for the decoding pipeline, with final training configurations selected manually by engineers.
